newsitem.title: UK: Regent Inns to raise 13.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Regent Inns to raise 13.6 mln stg.

text.p: Regent Inns Plc said on Tuesday that it would raise about 13.6 million stg by issuing 4.22 million shares to institutional investors.
Regent said each five pence share was being placed at 325 pence.
Regent said it was planning to dispose of its snooker division, negotiations for which were still going on.

The group said it had recently invested 10 million stg in new sites under development, most of which would open before June 30, 1997. Regent said the proceeds of the issue would help it to partially fund its future acquisition programme which would aim at having a portfolio of 200 trading sites by June 2002.
